claim: GlobalPetrolPrices.com's Q2 2026 update puts the world average residential electricity price at USD 0.176/kWh (nominal, averaged across the countries it tracks), up 6.12% from Q2 2025, ranging from USD 0.088/kWh in Asia to USD 0.261/kWh in Oceania.

sources.title: GlobalPetrolPrices.com – Electricity prices around the world (Q2 2026 update)

verification.note: Out of window: the GlobalPetrolPrices page carries no publication date, so published is 'seen' = 2026-10-01, after the 2026-09-30 window end. Also unsupported details: the page doesn't state 'nominal' or 'averaged across the countries it tracks', and its own text names Europe (0.254), not Oceania (0.261), as the highest region, so the claimed range conflicts with the source. Figures 0.176 and +6.12% are on the page; re-gather it in the next window with a dated source.
